title: Dawnguard
description: The war between the Dawnguard and the Volkihar vampires over the Tyranny of the Sun prophecy, with a choice of side midway through the story.

items.title: Dawnguard
items.giver: Guard rumors or the recruiter Durak
items.description: Once you hear the Dawnguard is recruiting, head to the canyon east of Riften and join Isran's order of vampire hunters. Available from level 10.
tips: Even if you plan to side with the vampires, the story starts with the Dawnguard.

items.title: Awakening
items.description: Check Dimhollow Crypt with Durak, where vampires are searching for something. Deep inside you find and free Serana, an ancient vampire carrying an Elder Scroll.

items.title: Bloodline
items.description: Escort Serana home to Castle Volkihar and her father, Lord Harkon. He offers you a "gift": to become a Vampire Lord. This is where you pick your side in the war.
items.missable: The choice of side is final: the other side's quests become unavailable.

options.label: Accept the gift (Volkihar Vampires)
options.result: You become a Vampire Lord and play for the Volkihar Clan. Dawnguard quests are closed, and Fort Dawnguard turns hostile.

options.label: Refuse (Dawnguard)
options.result: Harkon throws you out of the castle. You return to Isran and fight for the Dawnguard; Serana joins you later.

items.title: A New Order
items.description: Fight off the vampire attack on the fort and recruit Isran's old allies, Gunmar and Sorine Jurard.

items.title: Prophet
items.description: Reading Serana's Elder Scroll takes a Moth Priest. Find Dexion Evicus, held captive by vampires, and free him.

items.title: Ancient Technology
items.location: Random Dwemer ruins and bandit camps
items.description: Retrieve Dwemer schematics for Sorine six times. Each one unlocks smithing for new crossbows and exploding bolts.
tips: The last schematic is the Enhanced Dwarven Crossbow, one of the best ranged weapons in the DLC.

items.title: Preemptive Strike
items.description: Repeatable: kill a master vampire who plans to turn a gang of outlaws into vampires. Reward: a random enchanted weapon.

items.title: Hunting the Monster
items.description: Repeatable: get a townsperson who knows the vampire to talk, take the letter with the lair's location, and kill the master vampire.

items.title: Rescue
items.description: Repeatable: vampires have kidnapped a friend of yours, possibly even your spouse or a Jarl. Kill the kidnapper and free the captive.

items.title: The Bloodstone Chalice
items.description: Fill the Bloodstone Chalice with the blood of a Daughter of Coldharbour at the Redwater Den bloodspring to strengthen the clan.

items.title: Prophet
items.description: Find the Moth Priest Dexion Evicus, who is hiding in Forebears' Holdout, and bring him back to read the Elder Scroll.

items.title: Protecting the Bloodline
items.description: Repeatable: kill a rogue vampire who plans to build his own clan out of bandits.

items.title: Deceiving the Herd
items.description: Repeatable: kill a victim in front of witnesses and plant a letter to frame the Dawnguard.
tips: Wearing Dawnguard armor is safer: the bounty for the murder won't be pinned on you.

items.title: The Gift
items.description: If you are married, Vingalmo explains how to turn your spouse: charm them with Vampire's Seduction and feed on them.
tips: Your spouse won't become a real vampire: the change is mostly cosmetic.

items.title: Destroying the Dawnguard
items.description: After finishing the vampire storyline, clear out Fort Dawnguard and kill its leaders.
items.missable: Isran, Sorine, Gunmar and other Dawnguard members die for good, along with their shops and quests.

items.title: Scroll Scouting
items.description: The prophecy needs all three Elder Scrolls. If you already have the Dragon scroll from the main quest, use it; otherwise find out where to look for the rest.
tips: If you sold the scroll to Urag gro-Shub, buying it back costs 4,000 gold (2,000 for the Arch-Mage).

items.title: Chasing Echoes
items.description: Serana remembers her mother Valerica and her garden. Solve the secrets of the Castle Volkihar courtyard and open the portal to the Soul Cairn.

items.title: Beyond Death
items.description: Enter the Soul Cairn, find Valerica and destroy the Keepers so she will hand over the second Elder Scroll.
tips: You can't enter the Soul Cairn alive: either become a Vampire Lord or let Serana partially soul trap you (the penalty lasts while you're there).

items.title: Seeking Disclosure
items.description: Bring both Elder Scrolls to Dexion so he can read the Tyranny of the Sun prophecy.

items.title: Unseen Visions
items.description: Perform the ceremony at Ancestor Glade to read the Elder Scroll: find a Moth Priest's draw knife, gather Canticle Tree bark and attract the Ancestor Moths.

items.title: Touching the Sky
items.description: Pass through Darkfall Cave into the Forgotten Vale, meet the Snow Elf Gelebor and climb to the top of Auriel's Chapel. Vyrthur, Gelebor's brother turned vampire, awaits there. Reward: Auriel's Bow.
tips: The Wayshrines of Auriel are hidden around the Vale — find them all for a reward from Gelebor.

items.title: Kindred Judgment
items.description: The DLC finale: stop Harkon before he fulfills the prophecy. Both sides end up fighting Lord Harkon.
tips: After the finale, Falion in Morthal can cure Serana of vampirism.

items.title: Lost to the Ages
items.location: Arkngthamz, Deep Folk Crossing, Mzulft, Raldbthar, Ruins of Bthalft
items.description: Collect the four Aetherium Shards and find the Dwemer Aetherium Forge. It can craft only one item. You can also grab the bow Zephyr along the way.
items.missable: The forge works only once: the other two Aetherium items are gone for good.

choices.question: What to craft at the Aetherium Forge?

options.label: Aetherial Crown
options.result: Lets you have two Standing Stone effects at once.

options.label: Aetherial Shield
options.result: A shield bash banishes the enemy to the ether for a while.

items.title: Impatience of a Saint
items.description: The soul of Jiub, a hero of Morrowind, asks you to collect the 10 pages of his autobiography scattered around the Soul Cairn. Reward: Saint Jiub's Opus and the Locket of Saint Jiub.

items.title: Find Arvak's Skull
items.giver: A soul in the Soul Cairn
items.description: Find the skull of Arvak, the spectral horse, in the Soul Cairn to get the Summon Arvak spell.
